card.name: Rate units in infusion dosing
card.fires_on: Parts of a rate expression such as the slash, per, mg or mL in "mg/min", "mL/hr" or "per kg per min", in infusion and dosing text. Also fires on a list-number bracket or an odd space before a number.

modes.label: Rate unit pieces
modes.description: The slash, "per", or unit letters inside a rate like mg/min, mL/hr or microdrops/minute.

modes.label: Before a number or list item
modes.description: An opening bracket or space just before a number, such as a numbered list item or a flow rate value.
modes.example: and<< (>>5) have a reservoir made of poly

modes.label: Duration wording
modes.description: The word prolonged before parenteral administration, a time-course word near continuous infusion.
modes.example: may reach toxic levels with<< prolonged>> parenteral administration

card.writes: It lowers continuous and ongoing words, so the text is less likely to say the infusion is continuous right after a rate unit.
card.plain: It marks the unit pieces of infusion rates, like mg per min or mL per hour.
